div.head: Iud Dei XIII 12.2
div.ab: Adiuro autem té, aqua, per nomen Christi et praecipio tibi, ut nobis obędias per nomen eius, cui omnis creatura seruit, quem Cherubim et Seraphim collaudant, dicentes ‘Sanctus Sanctus Sanctus dominus Deus exercituum’, qui regnat et dominatur Deus per infinita seculorum secula. Amen.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 423 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: But I adjure you, water, by the name of Christ, and I command you to obey us by the name of him whom every creature serves, whom the Cherubim and Seraphim praise together, saying ‘Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of hosts’, who reigns and rules as God through infinite ages of ages. Amen.
